title: Sea Swell Place Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
meta_description: Sea Swell Place, a stunning coastal home located in the coveted Seacrest Beach community on Scenic 30A. Includes 3 living areas * Steps to Beach & Pool + 2 BIKES!
description_expanded: **SNOWBIRD PROMOTION- Save 50% PER NIGHT January and February for monthly stays!** HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - ACCESS TO THE PUBLIC WIDE BEACH (OR PRIVATE FOR MAIN TOWNS) WITH NO RESTRICTIONS - Short walk to private beach and lagoon style community pool - Beach tram pickup service available - 2 adult sized beach cruisers included - Fully stocked kitchen complete with a standard drip coffee maker and Keurig - Sandpiper Linen Program Participant: All linen, bedding and bath, are the highest quality. OPTIONAL ADD-ONS **Optional Cancellation Protection**- Allows cancellation for ANY reason up to 48 hours in advance of stay and guarantees 50% of all monies paid returned ($150 fee applies at booking). Welcome to Sea Swell Place, a stunning coastal home located in the coveted Seacrest Beach community on Scenic 30A. Just two blocks from the beach and only 30 steps from the renowned 12,000 sq. ft. lagoon-style community pool, this spacious retreat offers the perfect balance of luxury, comfort, and convenience. Designed to accommodate up to 14 guests, this home features 4 bedrooms, 2 lofts, and 3.5 bathrooms, making it ideal for large families or groups of friends. The updated kitchen is a chef’s dream, complete with granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, and counter seating for six, ensuring everyone can gather together for meals. The adjacent dining room, with seating for six additional guests, makes family dinners and game nights easy and enjoyable. After dinner, retreat to the expansive family room, where a large flat-screen TV and DVD player await for your relaxation and entertainment. Designed with outdoor living in mind, Sea Swell Place features multiple porches and three separate hangout areas, offering plenty of space for everyone to spread out, unwind, and soak in the fresh coastal air. Whether you’re enjoying a morning coffee on the porch or reading a book by the pool, this home provides a place for everyone to find their perfect spot. For your convenience, the home has parking on both the side and front, along with ample public parking nearby. In addition to the home’s inviting amenities, guests can enjoy two bikes, beach chairs, and easy access to some of the best attractions along 30A. Sea Swell Place is within walking distance to the charming communities of Alys Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Seacrest Village, where you can explore boutique shopping, dine at delicious restaurants, and enjoy live music just minutes away. ACCOMMODATIONS: Main Floor" Bedroom 1: Queen bed, TV Bedroom 2: Queen bed, TV Shared hallway bathroom. Full size front loading washer and dryer. Second Floor: Open living space at top of stairs with a set of built-in bunks (sleeps 2). Entertainment center perfect for a kid's hangout with Playstation 3! Small chair with a twin pullout sleeper sofa in this loft area (sleeps only 1 additional child). Bedroom 3: Queen size bed, two twin beds, and a large walkout balcony, TV (room sleeps up to 4) Hall bath accessible from the living space and side bedroom. Bedroom 4: King bed with private walkout balcony that overlooks Seacrest Beach Blvd, en-suite bathroom that features dual sinks, a jetted tub/shower combination, and a private water closet, TV Third Floor: Open area "tower" with twin bed and trundle (sleeps 2). Half bath Small bar and sink, coffee maker and wine refrigerator. IMPORTANT DETAILS: ** Renter must be 25+ years to rent ** No pets allowed ** Per HOA rules, no golf carts are allowed in this community **Access to Seacrest private beach, community pools and tram service *Certificate #219158 TDT#27199 FREE Wifi

Health And Safety: High touch surfaces cleaned with disinfectant
Towels and bedding washed in water that's at least 60sC/140sF
